Name: Rainbow Gemstone Crystal Path
Author: Reneeeeeeee
Description:
I made a recolour of Kirtini's Filled In Crystal Path but wasn't entirely happy with it. I realised what I really wanted was to change the entire look of the path. This is a rainbow crystal path with a whole new shape. I haven't changed the icon for the crystal path because I don't know how, but feel free to modify the files and upload an improved version if you want! If you like the shape of the path but the rainbow look is a bit much for you, feel free to recolour and upload recoloured versions. I will probably not update this myself.

Edit: I am updating the mod. I figured out how to change the icon.

Manifest.Name: Rainbow Crystal Path
Manifest.Description: A rainbow gemstone replacement of the Crystal Path.
